# Gola Handcrafted

Official website: https://www.gola-handcrafted.eu

## Purpose
Gola Handcrafted is the official website of a premium handcrafted handbag brand focused on wood-and-leather bags and artisan fashion accessories.

## Main pages
- Home (EN): https://www.gola-handcrafted.eu/en
- Home (BG): https://www.gola-handcrafted.eu/bg

## Products / Services
- Handcrafted wooden and leather handbags
- Inquiry-based orders for availability and custom requests

## Brand
Gola Handcrafted creates premium handcrafted handbags combining natural wood, leather, and refined artisan design.
